title: Concept: Fixed-length copy may leave the string unterminated (c)
description: In c, strncpy copies at most n bytes and does not promise a terminator. Truncation then becomes an out-of-bounds read at the first length, print or compare call.
applicability: Path and hostname handling in C code, where 63-byte limits are common.
risk: Out-of-bounds read that leaks adjacent memory or crashes the process; MEDIUM severity.
